proxy_initialized_flag.meaning: value of the proxy's initialized flag before any initialize call
proxy_initialized_flag.checkpoint: before initialize call on freshly deployed proxy

initialize_caller_authorized.meaning: whether the caller invoking initialize is an authorized party (report states no caller access control exists, so authorization is not established)
initialize_caller_authorized.checkpoint: before initialize call on freshly deployed proxy

implementation_constructor_initialized_p.meaning: whether the constructor-with-initializer ran on this proxy instance (report states it runs only on the implementation, not on each proxy)
implementation_constructor_initialized_p.checkpoint: before initialize call on freshly deployed proxy

attacker_has_full_admin.meaning: whether the first external caller holds full admin control over DistributionCreator and Distributor after initialization
attacker_has_full_admin.checkpoint: after initialize call on freshly deployed proxy

assumptions: The first external caller is an arbitrary unauthorized address, not a party authorized by the protocol.
The malicious accessControlManager contract treats the attacker as governor or guardian, so governance checks resolve in the attacker's favor.
The proxy has not yet been legitimately initialized by the protocol team when the attacker calls initialize.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker must be the very first caller or merely any caller before legitimate initialization, nor the exact timing/order relative to legitimate deployment; the plan uses the report's 'first external caller' framing.

Report does not state whether initialize can be called more than once or whether the initializer modifier prevents re-initialization after takeover; the post-takeover admin state is treated as a single checkpoint.

limitations: The impact is potential; the relation encodes the forbidden outcome (unauthorized caller gaining full admin) as the violation witness rather than an inevitable effect.
Full admin control is represented as a single grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric or per-function breakdown of the admin privileges.
Only the attacker_full_admin_control impact is formalized here; other impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
